Uz.bar_b_note: A readable orange fox with a clear face and ears that stands taller than the ruler, but the noisy blue patterned coat and the flat grey stage with no sky, fog or time-of-day light leave it far from Palworld/Valheim finish.

Hf.bar_b_note: The fleece-and-horn ram carries the owner's naturalistic style well (B's rear-up flinch and side-lying faint read instantly), but the neutral stage has no world light or atmosphere, and A's twisted upside-down faint breaks the read.

Xs.bar_b_note: The ram model is at the style bar, but on a lightless neutral stage, and B's near-static flinch and upside-down black-and-white faint tangle sink the read.

Iw.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing read as a built half-timber wall, but a lone segment beside a low-detail pale boulder, on tiled grass under flat noon light with no haze or shafts, is short of Palworld base-building density and Valheim light.

Ys.bar_b_note: B's banded black-and-yellow snake has a strong hooded silhouette but floats metres above its shadow in both faint frames with an over-bright glowing belly, while A's grounded coils are a dark, muddy gold-mottled mass that loses the head at small size.

Nz.bar_b_note: A's matte slate-and-tan raptor matches the Galecrest style bar and its carrying flight reads, but the neutral stage has no world light, and B's silver-white over-bright plumage looks plastic.

Ct.bar_b_note: An appealing, readable elder villager with an earthy olive/moss/brown palette and no oxblood, but he is shown on a black void with no world light, and his rounder animated-film face sits apart from the naturalistic creature style.

Qg.bar_b_note: The fox's face and big ears read, but the patchy blue coat texture, a flinch that either hops off the floor (A) or barely moves (B), and a lightless stage keep it below Palworld finish.

top_changes.change: Do a pose pass on hurt and faint: make every hit react a clear flinch that keeps the feet planted (Uz B and Qg A hop; Qg B and Xs B barely move), settle every faint onto its side with the body touching its shadow, and remove the upside-down twisted faints (Hf A, Xs B) and the snake floating metres up (Ys B).

Do a material and value pass toward the owner's naturalistic bar: matte fur and feather instead of over-bright gloss (Nz B, Ys B belly), lift the snake's value separation and give it clean banding (Ys A), and replace the fox's noisy blue camo coat with readable fur colour blocks.

Ship the timber-framed homestead wall (Iw A: plank cap, stone footing, braced infill) as the placed piece, with real thickness and weathering, and set it in a lived-in homestead context instead of a lone card next to a low-detail boulder.
